nodes.name: stg_lca
nodes.description: One file release/hash/source-row; original payload retained. LCA is an application, not approval or a sponsorship promise. Annual wage assumes 2080h/52wk/26biweekly/12mo.

lineageDetails.sqlQuery: create table FACTS_INPUT.lca as select * from original.STAGING.stg_lca

pipeline.name: load_fact_inputs_lca
pipeline.description: scripts/load_fact_inputs.py copies fy2025-full.STAGING.stg_lca into fy2025-full.FACTS_INPUT.lca. Verified schema, source SHA and row hash; local DuckDB replay only.

lineageDetails.description: Cross-file local Python CTAS verified against schema and content hashes. Not inferred dbt ref, not Snowflake.

), typed as (
 select *,
 cast(try_strptime(nullif(trim(received_date_raw), ?),
  ['%Y-%m-%d', '%m/%d/%Y', '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S']) as date) as received_date,
 cast(try_strptime(nullif(trim(decision_date_raw), ?),
  ['%Y-%m-%d', '%m/%d/%Y', '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S']) as date) as decision_date,
 cast(try_strptime(nullif(trim(begin_date_raw), ?),
  ['%Y-%m-%d', '%m/%d/%Y', '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S']) as date) as begin_date,
 cast(try_strptime(nullif(trim(end_date_raw), ?),
  ['%Y-%m-%d', '%m/%d/%Y', '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S']) as date) as end_date,
 case
 when regexp_full_match(trim(soc_code_raw), ?) then substr(trim(soc_code_raw),?,?)
 when regexp_full_match(trim(soc_code_raw), ?) then substr(trim(soc_code_raw),?,?)||?||substr(trim(soc_code_raw),?,?)
 else null end as soc_code,
 upper(trim(employer_state_raw)) as employer_state,
 upper(trim(worksite_state_raw)) as worksite_state,
 upper(trim(regexp_replace(replace(replace(worksite_county_raw, ?, ?), chr(?), ?), ?, ?, ?))) as worksite_county,
 upper(trim(regexp_replace(replace(replace(worksite_city_raw, ?, ?), chr(?), ?), ?, ?, ?))) as worksite_city,

 case when regexp_full_match(trim(worksite_postal_code_raw), ?)
      then left(trim(worksite_postal_code_raw), ?)
      when regexp_full_match(trim(worksite_postal_code_raw), ?)
      then ? || trim(worksite_postal_code_raw) end as worksite_zip5,
 try_cast(wage_amount_raw as decimal(?,?)) as wage_amount,
 case when regexp_full_match(trim(worker_positions_raw), ?)
 then try_cast(trim(worker_positions_raw) as decimal(?,?)) else null end as worker_positions
 from mapped
)

select t.*, md5(coalesce(employer_country,?)||?||coalesce(employer_name,?)||?||coalesce(employer_state,?)||?||coalesce(employer_fein,?)||?||coalesce(employer_city,?)||?||coalesce(employer_zip,?)) as source_employer_key, (cast(t.wage_amount as decimal(?,?)) *
 case t.wage_unit
   when ? then ? when ? then ? when ? then ?
   when ? then ? when ? then ? else null
 end)::decimal(?,?) as annual_wage,
 s.state_fips,
 coalesce(c.county_fips, z.county_fips, p.county_fips) as county_fips,
 coalesce(c.geography_vintage, z.geography_vintage, p.geography_vintage) as geography_vintage,
 case when c.county_fips is not null then ?
      when z.county_fips is not null then ?
      when p.county_fips is not null then ?
      when t.worksite_county is null then ?
      else ? end as geography_status,
 case when c.county_fips is not null then ?
      else coalesce(z.match_rule, p.match_rule) end as county_match_rule,
 c.county_fips is null and z.county_fips is null and p.county_fips is null as geo_unresolved,
 t.soc_code is null as soc_unresolved
from typed t
left join "fy2025-full"."STAGING"."state_fips" s on s.state_code = t.worksite_state
left join "fy2025-full"."STAGING"."county_fips" c
 on c.state_code = t.worksite_state and c.county_name = t.worksite_county
left join "fy2025-full"."STAGING"."zcta_county_fips" z
 on z.zcta = t.worksite_zip5 and z.state_fips = s.state_fips
left join "fy2025-full"."STAGING"."place_county_fips" p
 on p.state_code = t.worksite_state and p.place_name = t.worksite_city

), typed as (

 cast(try_strptime(nullif(trim(begin_date_raw), ?),
  ['%Y-%m-%d', '%m/%d/%Y', '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S']) as date) as begin_date,
 cast(try_strptime(nullif(trim(end_date_raw), ?),
  ['%Y-%m-%d', '%m/%d/%Y', '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S']) as date) as end_date,
 case
 when regexp_full_match(trim(soc_code_raw), ?) then substr(trim(soc_code_raw),?,?)
 when regexp_full_match(trim(soc_code_raw), ?) then substr(trim(soc_code_raw),?,?)||?||substr(trim(soc_code_raw),?,?)
 else null end as soc_code,
 upper(trim(employer_state_raw)) as employer_state,
 upper(trim(worksite_state_raw)) as worksite_state,
 upper(trim(regexp_replace(replace(replace(worksite_county_raw, ?, ?), chr(?), ?), ?, ?, ?))) as worksite_county,
 upper(trim(regexp_replace(replace(replace(worksite_city_raw, ?, ?), chr(?), ?), ?, ?, ?))) as worksite_city,

 case when regexp_full_match(trim(worksite_postal_code_raw), ?)
      then left(trim(worksite_postal_code_raw), ?)
      when regexp_full_match(trim(worksite_postal_code_raw), ?)
      then ? || trim(worksite_postal_code_raw) end as worksite_zip5,
 try_cast(wage_amount_raw as decimal(?,?)) as wage_amount,
 case when regexp_full_match(trim(worker_positions_raw), ?)
 then try_cast(trim(worker_positions_raw) as decimal(?,?)) else null end as worker_positions
 from mapped
)

select t.*, md5(coalesce(employer_country,?)||?||coalesce(employer_name,?)||?||coalesce(employer_state,?)||?||coalesce(employer_fein,?)||?||coalesce(employer_city,?)||?||coalesce(employer_zip,?)) as source_employer_key, (cast(t.wage_amount as decimal(?,?)) *
 case t.wage_unit
   when ? then ? when ? then ? when ? then ?
   when ? then ? when ? then ? else null
 end)::decimal(?,?) as annual_wage,
 s.state_fips,
 coalesce(c.county_fips, z.county_fips, p.county_fips) as county_fips,
 coalesce(c.geography_vintage, z.geography_vintage, p.geography_vintage) as geography_vintage,
 case when c.county_fips is not null then ?
      when z.county_fips is not null then ?
      when p.county_fips is not null then ?
      when t.worksite_county is null then ?
      else ? end as geography_status,
 case when c.county_fips is not null then ?
      else coalesce(z.match_rule, p.match_rule) end as county_match_rule,
 c.county_fips is null and z.county_fips is null and p.county_fips is null as geo_unresolved,
 t.soc_code is null as soc_unresolved
from typed t
left join "fy2025-full"."STAGING"."state_fips" s on s.state_code = t.worksite_state
left join "fy2025-full"."STAGING"."county_fips" c
 on c.state_code = t.worksite_state and c.county_name = t.worksite_county
left join "fy2025-full"."STAGING"."zcta_county_fips" z
 on z.zcta = t.worksite_zip5 and z.state_fips = s.state_fips
left join "fy2025-full"."STAGING"."place_county_fips" p
 on p.state_code = t.worksite_state and p.place_name = t.worksite_city

create table "fy2025-full"."INTERMEDIATE"."int_lca_case_candidates" as

select l.*,m.employer_id,m.occupation_key,m.geography_key,
 m.occupation_mapping_status,m.county_mapping_status,
 count(*) over(partition by l.case_number) as source_occurrence_count,
 count(*) over(partition by l.case_number,l.decision_date,l.received_date,l.fiscal_year) as chronological_tie_count,
 row_number() over(partition by l.case_number order by
 l.decision_date desc nulls last,l.received_date desc nulls last,l.fiscal_year desc,
 l.source_release desc,l.source_sha256,l.source_row_number) as winner_rank
from "fy2025-full"."FACTS_INPUT"."lca" l
left join "fy2025-full"."INTERMEDIATE"."int_dimension_mapping" m
 on l.source_system=m.source_system and l.source_release=m.source_release
 and l.source_sha256=m.source_sha256 and l.source_row_number=m.source_row_number
